mustFix.issue: (d) abbreviation not spelled out on first use (style-guide §2 「略語は初出で正式名を書きます」): the changed sentence 「macOS・Linux・WSL用は、2行で1つのコマンドです。」 is now the first use of WSL in the lesson, and WSL is spelled out nowhere. The replacement below removes the 「、」 so the paragraph stays at 160 chars (checked with lessons:lint --strict on a scratch copy: 0 warnings).
mustFix.fix: 「macOS・Linux・WSL用は、2行で1つのコマンドです。」→「macOS・Linux・WSL（Windows Subsystem for Linux）用は2行で1つのコマンドです。」

niceToHave: install-how: 「2行で1つのコマンド」 could be read as "two commands on two lines". Saying the line was split for display is clearer, but it costs characters, so shorten another sentence if you use it — 「2行で1つのコマンドです。」→「2行に分けて表示した1つのコマンドです。」
install-unix / install-win: the filenames now use two styles side by side, 「macOS・Linux・WSL」 and 「PowerShell (Windows)」. Matching them reads better — 「PowerShell (Windows)」→「Windows・PowerShell」
surfaces-table: (carried) 「JetBrains版」 differs from 「IDE拡張（JetBrains）」 in q2 and q6 — 「JetBrains版はCLIが別に必要」→「JetBrainsの拡張はCLIが別に必要」

summary: Verification round: review-scope.mjs exited 0, with 4 of 43 blocks changed (5%). The previous review had no open must-fix items, so resolved is empty.
